root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by concurrent updates to bitfield members within `struct cached_fid`, which result in non-atomic byte-level read-modify-write operations that can inadvertently restore stale values of flags modified by other threads.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that `is_open`, `has_lease`, and `on_list` are stored in the same bitfield byte and "Bitfield assignments generate byte read–modify–write operations... so updating one flag can restore stale values of the others," illustrating an interleaving where a CPU reloads a stale byte after another clears bits; the patch diff resolves this by converting the `bool:1` bitfields to standard `bool` fields in `fs/smb/client/cached_dir.h`.
